B014.name: task_formation_move
doc: Formation mover task: for every slot with b1 in formation_flags,
point the slot pointers $1084-$10CB at its data, set its sprite
up on the first visit (b7), then step its path ($B0D4) or home in
on its formation position ($B242). Rewinds formation_ptr at $188D.

B0D4.name: formation_path_step
doc: Step a slot along its path: counter [$1090] minus speed [$10AD];
at 0 the path pointer advances: $F0 end, $FF/$FE new heading +

B163.name: formation_move_sprite
doc: Move by <$98 units along heading A (dat_AAFF + 4*A: dy, dx, bits).

B242.name: formation_home
doc: Turn towards the formation position (octant tables dat_A9D6,
A96A, AA39, AA9C) or arrive within 4 units.

1096.name: formation_slot
1096.comment: sub: index of the slot $B014 works on ($FF = none)

111D.name: object_state
111D.comment: sub: state of the 4 objects ($0EE2+10k), object_states
